scope: Descriptive calibration only on complete m1-natural source L_s and held-out source V, one source RX, three source days and six transmitters. No U labels, U IQ, target data, training or checkpoint selection.
reason: r01 stopped before any source data measurement because the reused historical ordinary PL source configuration has no paper_row field. r02 obtains its matching row from the registered paper plan, verifies its seed, and uses a new immutable run and release.
method: Load the already-frozen same-contract ordinary PL, original Tri, day and day_physics E50 models for all three matched seeds. Measure source V accuracy, threshold-0.95 acceptance and accepted errors overall, by source day and by transmitter. Build five-branch true-label centroids from full source L_s, excluding the queried source day, and measure the accepted fraction and label errors that pass four branch votes before and after a bounded-echo source-only proxy. This full-L-bank bounded-echo diagnostic is not a replay of the minibatch As gate and cannot measure hidden-U truth.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --source-probe --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account, immutable release and unique source diagnostic output root; available GPU 0–7, no more than two observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners.
stop_rule: Stop on invalid source roles/contract, unavailable frozen parent, or technical failure; preserve logs and outputs. No target scoring or training in this diagnostic.
expected_artifacts: 12 frozen model source-only accuracy and calibration summaries by source day and transmitter
Five-branch raw and bounded-echo certificate acceptance/error counts
Explicit evidence that U and target were not read
